dedupe_keys.name: indicadores de confiabilidade da rede basica dreq freq

description: ONS publishes DREQ equivalent load-interruption duration in minutes and FREQ equivalent interruption frequency. The dictionary identifies aggregation, characteristic, reporting period and indicator value. Monthly and annual series cover the national interconnected system and several geographic or operational groupings. These indicators support electricity-service reliability studies. Equivalent aggregate rates do not identify individual outage durations or the affected network components. Coverage is SIN, subsystems, geographic regions and states in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
